body.purpose: Default UI voice across all functional strings.

label.purpose: Uppercase section captions and compact meta labels.

shadows.name: shadow-medium

shadows.name: shadow-heavy
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on cards and circular action buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled Deep Slate action; lifts one step on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--primary-color); color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-medium); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outline toolbar button; hover and focus recolor the hairline border only.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-1); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--divider-color); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface-color); color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--primary-color); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary-color); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface-color), 0 0 0 4px var(--primary-color); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Glass Icon Button
components.description: Round veil control that sits on photos; hover deepens the veil and scales 1.1.
components.html: <button class='ds-btn-glass' aria-label='Zoom in'><svg width='18' height='18' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' aria-hidden='true'><circle cx='11' cy='11' r='8'></circle><line x1='21' y1='21' x2='16.65' y2='16.65'></line><line x1='11' y1='8' x2='11' y2='14'></line><line x1='8' y1='11' x2='14' y2='11'></line></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--viewer-btn-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.5); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.5); color: var(--viewer-btn-color); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast); } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: var(--viewer-btn-hover-bg); transform: scale(1.1); }

components.name: Photo Card
components.description: Contact-sheet frame: flat paper at rest, caption gradient fades in on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--divider-color); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-color); box-shadow: var(--shadow-light); transition: box-shadow var(--transition-medium), border-color var(--transition-medium); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-heavy); border-color: var(--primary-light); } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--background-secondary); } .ds-card-caption { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 20px; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(to top, oklch(0% 0 0deg / 70%) 0%, transparent 100%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--transition-medium); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-caption { opacity: 1; } .ds-card-caption strong { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.2px; } .ds-card-caption span { font-size: 13px; color: oklch(100% 0 0deg / 90%); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Resting on paper with a hairline; focus turns the border slate and brightens to surface.
components.html: <input class='ds-input-search' type='search' placeholder='AI-powered photo search' aria-label='Search' />
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; max-width: 600px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--divider-color); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--background-color); color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-body); transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), background var(--transition-fast); } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary-color); background: var(--surface-color); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Text-first nav items on glass; the active item fills Deep Slate.
components.html: <nav class='ds-nav'><button class='ds-nav-item'>All Photos</button><button class='ds-nav-item active' aria-current='page'>Favorites</button><button class='ds-nav-item'>Albums</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 240px; padding: 16px; background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5); border-right: 1px solid var(--glass-border); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 15px/1.5 var(--font-body); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--background-secondary); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-nav-item.active { background: var(--primary-color); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-color); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Glass Dialog
components.description: Glass panel over a 60% scrim, entrance scale-and-settle in 0.3s.
components.html:
Edit metadata

Dates and coordinates are written straight into the photo's EXIF.
components.css: .ds-dialog { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; background: oklch(0% 0 0deg / 60%); } .ds-dialog-panel { width: 100%; max-width: 500px; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--divider-color); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); color: var(--text-primary); animation: ds-modal-in 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 20px/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-dialog-body { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); } @keyframes ds-modal-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) translateY(-20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); } }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-center glass pill; the leading icon carries the type.
components.html: Album created12 photos added
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5); color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-body); box-shadow: var(--shadow-heavy); animation: ds-toast-in 0.3s ease-out; } .ds-toast > svg { color: var(--primary-color); } .ds-toast-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-toast-body strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-toast-body span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

components.name: Toggle Chips
components.description: 32px full-radius pills; pressed state is a 12% slate mix with a slate border.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip { height: 32px; min-width: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--divider-color); border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 12px/1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast), background-color var(--transition-fast); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--primary-color); color: var(--primary-color); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: var(--primary-color); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary-color) 12%, transparent); color: var(--primary-dark); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface-color), 0 0 0 4px var(--primary-color); }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a contact sheet on a light table: every photo gets the same quiet frame, the grid is the reading surface, and nothing in the chrome competes with the pictures. Browsing is scanning a proof sheet — calm, spacious, understated — and the only marks on the paper are the user's own: favorites in warm brass, selections and focus in deep slate.

Two materials carry the system. **Matte paper** — warm off-white surfaces, 1px hairlines at half opacity, ambient shadows — holds the content. **Layered glass** — translucent, blurred chrome that floats above (header, sidebar, control bars, dialogs, toasts) — carries the interface. Light mode is daylight paper (canvas at oklch 97.5%, hue 80); dark mode is the same room with the lights off (canvas at 14%) where the photos glow.

Type keeps the print register: Playfair Display for identity and section headings, DM Sans for everything functional, on a 4px rhythm. Motion is a courtesy, not a performance: three durations on one easing family (0.15 / 0.3 / 0.5s, cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)), one spring for view transitions, and both reduced-motion and reduced-transparency fallbacks built in.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces, deep slate interaction, exactly one brass mark.
Two materials only: matte paper and layered glass.
Contact-sheet grid: equal frames, generous gutters, chrome recedes.
Editorial serif for identity; a quiet sans for every UI string.
Motion 0.15/0.3/0.5s, one easing family, fully degradable.

rules.name: The Grease-Pencil Rule
rules.body: Warm Brass marks only human actions and rare attention — favorites, a single retry. Keep it to small areas; its scarcity is the point.

rules.name: The Warm Paper Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces stay warm (hue 80, chroma ≤ 0.005) and text stays cool (hue 260). Never substitute pure gray for paper or a warm hue for ink.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display speaks for identity and section headings only; every functional string is DM Sans.

rules.name: The One-Step Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover moves a surface exactly one shadow step — light→heavy on cards, veil→veil-deep on glass icon buttons — with a scale of at most 1.15 on round controls.

rules.name: The Solid Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every glass surface must degrade to a solid paper surface under `prefers-reduced-transparency` or missing `backdrop-filter` (the scrim deepens to 92% black).

rules.name: The Four-Step Radius Rule
rules.body: Radii come from 4 / 6 / 8 / full and nothing else; the 2px progress track is legacy drift, not a scale.

dos: Do let photos lead: the contact-sheet grid is the primary surface; chrome recedes behind paper tones and 1px hairlines.
Do keep interaction singular: Deep Slate for active, selected, and focus states, mixed translucently (12–45%) for large areas.
Do reserve Warm Brass for marks a person makes (favorites) and rare attention moments — small areas only.
Do pair every glass surface with its solid fallback for reduced transparency and missing `backdrop-filter` support.
Do build on the 4px spacing scale and keep ≥44px touch targets in viewer and mobile chrome.
Do keep Playfair Display for identity headings only; all UI strings use DM Sans.
Do use feather icons only (16–24px inline, no emoji).
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` and `prefers-reduced-transparency` in every new effect.
donts: Don't fill large surfaces with Warm Brass or introduce new saturated hues.
Don't add shadows beyond light/medium/heavy, and never reference tokens that don't exist (an undefined `--shadow-lg` reference once silently removed the dialogs' shadow).
Don't use radius values outside 4/6/8/full — the 2px progress track is legacy drift.
Don't hardcode hex or rgb colors in new components — error boxes and toast accents come from the danger/success/accent tokens.
Don't use pure gray surfaces or warm text; paper stays warm (hue 80), ink stays cool (hue 260).
Don't rely on `--font-mono`: the JetBrains Mono token ships no web font.
Don't ship interactive controls without a visible `:focus-visible` treatment.
Don't use emoji or non-feather icon sets.
